market.what: Phenol (what lignin phenolics replace, e.g. in PF resins), world
market.job_what: lignin sold for chemical use today (lignosulfonates + kraft lignin), world; no lignin depolymerization catalyst sold commercially
market.job_method: lignosulfonates ~1.65 Mt/yr = ~$0.80B (2023 report) + kraft lignin sold ~0.1 Mt x ~$0.8/kg (est.) = ~$0.08B; low-med confidence

value.logic: Kraft lignin ~55 Mt/yr, 98% burned. Pull 5 Mt (~10%): 0.35 t aromatics/t x $1,100 = $385/t, minus $60 lost fuel value, minus ~$200 processing (est.) = ~$125/t x 5 Mt = $0.6B
value.revenue_logic: 2-3 plants, 125 kt lignin/yr by yr 7 -> 44 kt aromatics x $1.1/kg = $48M x 5% royalty = $2.4M + catalyst ~1 kg/t x $50/kg = $6M
value.margin_logic: Mix of license (90) and supported-metal catalyst sales (~50)

trend.drivers: Phenol demand +2-3%/yr; bio-based phenol for PF resins (Stora Enso Lineo); RCF lignin oil MSP now ~EUR 1,000/t

competition.notes: Very crowded science. Bloom $14.7M Series A Apr 2025; Lignin Industries EUR 3.9M May 2025. Economics hinge on monomer yield from real kraft lignin

lab.synth: Supported metal catalyst (Ni/Mo/Ru on carbon or oxide) by impregnation from catalog supports, 3 variants; heterogeneous, so no CRO route
lab.test: Batch autoclave hydrogenolysis (Parr) of kraft lignin (Indulin AT) and birch wood RCF; monomer yield by GC-FID/GC-MS, GPC, HSQC NMR; recycle test; university lab
lab.logic: Catalyst prep + characterization 4-6 wk, $12k; reactor runs + analytics 8 wk, ~$30k; $3k lignin/consumables

sale.gates: Continuous pilot 1-2 yr; demo at pulp mill/biorefinery; resin buyer qualifies lignin phenolics 1 yr
